minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved the pump-station maintenance plan 4-1 over a member's objection, on DPW director Jack's last night.
minutes.summary: The commission met remotely, welcomed its new operations and maintenance contractor, and said farewell to the retiring DPW director. The main item was the pump-station maintenance plan, which was moved and approved as a working document despite one member's objection that it had been watered down. The board also discussed a sewer connection at 384 Mass Ave, reviewed invoices and billing, and set upcoming meeting dates.

The maintenance plan will return on future agendas and a workshop is wanted once the new DPW director starts, about two weeks out.
The commission will wait for the new DPW director before the plan is discussed again.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted 4-1 to start using the sewer system maintenance plan as a current draft, to be improved over time; one member voted no.
The plan will return on future agendas, with a workshop wanted once the new DPW director starts, about two weeks out.
The commission met a new operations and maintenance contractor and heard about pump station condition and obsolete controls.
For a sewer connection at 384 Mass Ave, the chair held that no delay is needed, and a copy of the state drawing is wanted for the files.
A member asked that his marked-up copy of the maintenance plan be entered into the record and distributed to the commission.

why_it_matters: The maintenance plan guides how the town's sewer pump stations are kept up, and repairs or replacements of aging equipment are paid for through sewer rates, so how complete the plan is bears on future sewer costs.
The plan was adopted as a working draft rather than a final document, so its scope may still change at the workshop and in later agenda items.
watch_next: Meetings are set for November 10 and November 17, with November 24 possible.
A maintenance plan workshop once the new DPW director starts, about two weeks out; copies of the plan are available at the DPW.
